stem: Based on the article “Alone in Nature,” how were Thoreau’s reasons for spending time in nature DIFFERENT from the speaker’s reasons in the poem “Wisdom in Wishes”?

options.label: A
options.text: Thoreau wanted to spend time with others, but the speaker wants to be alone.

options.label: B
options.text: Thoreau hoped to be able to spend time outdoors, but the speaker is already satisfied.

options.label: C
options.text: Thoreau enjoyed being outdoors for fun, but the speaker is required to go outside.

options.label: D
options.text: Thoreau aimed to make a point about society, but the speaker’s desire is personal.

visual_elements: 2023 – Q17 Passage #2A - Informational and Passage #2B - Poetry
